$comment: The action references that still float on a mutable tag TODAY, each with why.
A RATCHET: scripts/security/check-actions.mjs passes on what is listed here and
FAILS on anything that is not, so the debt is enumerable, it cannot grow, and
burning it down is deleting entries.
This is a JSON file rather than an array literal in the script for one reason:
`npm run security:actions -- --resolve` prunes the entries it burns down, and
.github/workflows/pin-actions.yml runs that weekly. An allowlist a machine has
to edit should not be source code.
Do NOT add an entry to make a red build green. The list is debt already
incurred, not a way to incur more.
EMPTY as of 2026-08-31: every action reference in .github/workflows/ is pinned
to a full commit SHA verified against the GitHub API. The ratchet stays here so
the next unpinned reference is a red build rather than a quiet regression.
